verdict.rationale: Skyvern's core model is a natural-language goal plus a starting URL (skyvern-docs-18). It then navigates sites it has never seen, fills forms, and completes multi-step tasks via its API (skyvern-docs-17, skyvern-gh-1, skyvern-docs-5), with documented examples such as auto-filling job applications (skyvern-docs-14). Hands-on users confirm it does well on the happy path and shows the steps it takes (skyvern-comm-2, skyvern-comm-9), but one tester saw it fail to click through a popup on costcotravel.com, which points to reliability limits rather than a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: evidence of consistent reliability on complex or unfamiliar flows, and broader independent end-to-end corroboration.
